V. 10.
And he ſent and beheaded John in the priſon, and his head was given to the damſel—How myſterious is the Providence, which left the Life of ſo holy a Man in ſuch infamous Hands! Which permitted it to be ſacrificed to the Malice of an abandoned Harlot, the Petulan•• of a vain Girl, and the Raſhneſs of a fooliſh, perhaps drunken P••••• who made a Prophet's Head the Reward of a Dance ••••t 〈…〉 ſure the Almighty will repay his Servants in another Wor•
〈◊〉 whatever they ſuffer in this.
